issues: Plan has 4 week(s) but 12 were requested.

plan.summary: This 4-week block starts a 12-week off-camp build for boxing with one weekly S&C session, so the plan stays simple, recoverable, and high value. Week 1 establishes a basic lower-body strength baseline with a safe bodyweight assessment, then Weeks 2-4 build explosive leg power, upper-body strength endurance, trunk strength, and short conditioning. With bodyweight-only equipment and beginner status, the focus is crisp movement, repeatable effort, and gradual workload progression rather than max loading.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build general strength, basic power, and work capacity with simple bodyweight patterns that stay easy to recover from around boxing.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress force and power with harder unilateral work, sharper jump intent, and slightly denser conditioning.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Keep strength while expressing faster, sharper bodyweight power and cleaner repeat-effort conditioning.

exercises.name: Countermovement Jump
exercises.notes: Jump as high as you can with a soft landing. Reset between reps and stop if height drops off.

substitutionOptions.name: Squat Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if countermovement timing feels messy. Start from a still quarter squat and jump fast.

exercises.name: Rear-Foot-Elevated Split Squat
exercises.notes: Use a slow lower and stand up hard. Hold balance and keep the front foot flat.

strengthAssessment.prompt: This session sets your baseline for future progress. Warm up with easy bodyweight reps, then perform one hard top set of 6 reps per side with a 3-second lowering phase, stopping when you are 0-1 reps from failure while keeping clean form. Log how many clean reps you could have done and how difficult it felt.

performanceTarget.prompt: Track your hardest clean set per side with the same tempo and full range.

substitutionOptions.name: Split Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if rear-foot elevation is too unstable. Keep the same slow lowering and upright posture.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.notes: Body stays straight, chest reaches full depth, and stop before form breaks.

substitutionOptions.name: Incline Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use hands on a bench, table, or sturdy surface if floor push-ups are too hard to keep clean.

substitutionOptions.name: Knee Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if no incline setup is available. Keep hips extended and chest moving as one piece.

exercises.name: Prone Back Widow Row
exercises.notes: Drive elbows into the floor and squeeze your upper back hard at the top.

substitutionOptions.name: Towel Door Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use only with a secure door setup. Keep your body stiff and pull under control.

exercises.name: Hollow Body Hold
exercises.notes: Lower back stays pressed down. Shorten the lever if you lose position.

substitutionOptions.name: Dead Bug
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if the hollow hold is too difficult to control. Move slowly and keep the ribs down.

exercises.name: High-Knee Shuttle Intervals
exercises.notes: Move fast but relaxed. Keep posture tall and land softly.

endurancePrescription.mode: high-knee running in place or short shuttles

exercises.name: Countermovement Jump
exercises.notes: Every rep should look fast and springy. Rest enough to keep jump height consistent.

substitutionOptions.name: Squat Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if countermovement timing still feels inconsistent.

exercises.name: Rear-Foot-Elevated Split Squat
exercises.notes: Lower under control for 3 seconds and drive up hard. Keep the same stance each set.

performanceTarget.prompt: Track your cleanest hardest set per side with the same tempo.

substitutionOptions.name: Split Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if balance limits the work more than your legs do.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.notes: Use a variation that lets every rep stay clean and powerful. Pause briefly at the floor if needed.

performanceTarget.prompt: Track the best clean set at your chosen variation without grinding.

substitutionOptions.name: Incline Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Raise the hands enough to keep full range and strong body position.

substitutionOptions.name: Knee Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if needed to keep all reps smooth and controlled.

exercises.name: Prone Back Widow Row
exercises.notes: Squeeze the shoulder blades together each rep and keep the neck relaxed.

substitutionOptions.name: Towel Door Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a secure setup and pull with full-body tension.

exercises.name: Reverse Crunch
exercises.notes: Curl the pelvis up, not just the legs. Lower slowly without swinging.

substitutionOptions.name: Bent-Knee Leg Raise
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if reverse crunches are easier to control from a hanging-free setup on the floor.

exercises.name: Tempo Squat Conditioning Circuit
exercises.notes: Move continuously with controlled breathing. Keep the squat depth honest and the pace steady.

endurancePrescription.work: 30 seconds bodyweight squats, 30 seconds mountain climbers, 30 seconds fast shadowboxing, 30 seconds rest

exercises.name: Countermovement Jump
exercises.notes: Stay explosive and land quietly. If jump quality drops, stop the set there.

substitutionOptions.name: Box Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a low stable box if available and if landing mechanics are solid.

exercises.name: Rear-Foot-Elevated Split Squat
exercises.notes: Use a 3-second lower on the first 2 sets, then normal control on the last 2 sets. Stand up with intent.

performanceTarget.prompt: Track the best set per side with stable balance and full depth.

substitutionOptions.name: Split Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if the rear-foot-elevated version still costs too much balance.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.notes: Choose the hardest variation you can own cleanly. Keep 1-2 good reps in reserve.

performanceTarget.prompt: Track your strongest clean set at the same variation.

substitutionOptions.name: Decline Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this only if regular push-ups are already easy for all sets.

substitutionOptions.name: Incline Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if floor reps still break down early.

exercises.name: Prone Back Widow Row
exercises.notes: Pause 1 second at the top of each rep and keep the ribs down.

substitutionOptions.name: Towel Door Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a secure anchor and pull to the lower ribs.

exercises.name: Hollow Body Hold
exercises.notes: Keep the low back flat the whole time. Shorten the lever before position breaks.

substitutionOptions.name: Reverse Crunch
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if long hollow holds cause low-back arching.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Repeat-Effort Intervals
exercises.notes: Work hard but keep every round tidy. Breathing should recover during the easy periods.

exercises.name: Countermovement Jump
exercises.notes: Stay quick and fresh. Stop well before the jumps feel heavy.

substitutionOptions.name: Squat Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if it helps you keep the reps cleaner and more repeatable.

exercises.name: Rear-Foot-Elevated Split Squat
exercises.notes: Keep the movement crisp and controlled. This week is for recovery, not grinding.

performanceTarget.prompt: Track one clean reference set per side and leave plenty in the tank.

substitutionOptions.name: Split Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if you want a slightly easier deload option.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.notes: Use a variation that feels smooth and powerful. Finish the set before speed drops off.

substitutionOptions.name: Incline Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Good deload choice if regular reps have been slowing down.

exercises.name: Prone Back Widow Row
exercises.notes: Own each rep and keep the upper back doing the work.

substitutionOptions.name: Towel Door Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a secure setup and keep the reps controlled.

exercises.name: Reverse Crunch
exercises.notes: Smooth reps only. Stop before you need momentum.

substitutionOptions.name: Dead Bug
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if you want an easier core option this week.

exercises.name: Easy Aerobic Tempo Block
exercises.notes: Keep it conversational and relaxed. The goal is to leave fresher than you started.

endurancePrescription.mode: shadowboxing, step work, or brisk marching in place
